notes.title: THE TRIALS UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Are you ready for some TRIALS???[/p][p]I bet you aren't....[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, you'll be, ahem, "TRIALLED" with new starting scenarios that provide EPIC gameplay.[/p][list][*][p]4 New Starting item scenarios:[/p][/*][*][p]3-ball: Race against time, reach the other side of the map before the bomb goes off[/p][/*][*][p]Aether-ball: Floating items only![/p][/*][*][p]Negative-One-Ball: Start with $750, money cannot go up![/p][/*][*][p]Eden ball: Less rounds per level... but start with a selection of items[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Curses[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update for stone-slots[/p][/*][*][p]New items and balancing of existing items[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so beating a level on HARD unlocks easier difficulties too[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with me throughout development o7.[/p][p]I think the game is at a point where it's ready to be lifted out of EA. I won't stop updating the game, but I think it's ready for full release.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, if you encounter any bugs/suggestions/ideas, please don't hesitate to join le discord.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: THE DOOMED UPDATE
notes.content: [p]In this update, I added a bunch more DOOMED items that synergize with existing stuff.[/p][p]Includes doomed-sword, doomed-scythe, doomed-shield, helmet, and crossbow.[/p][p][/p][p]I also added a few other changes here and there:[/p][p]- Fixed a bunch of bugs[/p][p]- Clarified some unclear descriptions[/p][p]- Made early-game less punishing for noobs by removing negative-bonus items[/p][p][/p][p]Happy gamin, folks ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː [/p]

notes.title: THE MARBLE UPDATE
notes.content: [p]- Added new trigger: "Buffed".[/p][p]- Added a bunch of new items.[/p][p]- A lot of bug fixes and small QoL tweaks.[/p][p][/p][p]Urn items: Activate when an item is buffed.[/p][p]This has many many use-cases, and can help with your economy early.[/p][p]Log / Sword hilt: Buffs sword/axe items.[/p][p]Mini-shield: A friendlier replacement to the early-game wooden-shield.[/p]

notes.title: HUUGE UDPATE (v1.2)
notes.content: [h1]THE GUARDIANS AND CURSES UPDATE[/h1][p]Hoo boy, this was a BIG BIG update.[/p][p]Daily runs were added, alongside a TONNE of new content, features, cosmetics, and systems.[/p][p][/p][h2]Biggest features:[/h2][list][*][p]Created randomized daily-runs[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new Curses system[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added over 30 new items[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added 6 new slots[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new music[/p][/*][/list][p]Alongside a plethora of other improvements and fixes.[/p]
